# Supabase browser SDK

Vendored public UMD distribution, pinned to `@supabase/supabase-js` **2.116.0**.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.116.0/dist/umd/supabase.js
- SHA-256: `84ee9bf45695c1dd3ba1595b6bcfb0f09672434631351ffc8ebe9140545d5ff6`
- License: `SUPABASE-LICENSE.txt` (MIT), from the same package/version.

The main v2 surface loads this local asset, including offline, instead of fetching an unpinned executable from a CDN during sign-in. The bundle contains no application configuration or private user data. Update the version, checksum, script reference and service-worker asset list together when upgrading.
